# Psalm 11 — Disagreement Log

## 11:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For behold, the-wicked bend the-bow; they-have-set their-arrow on-the-string, to-shoot in-darkness at-the-upright of-heart.
- **LOGOS:** For behold, the wicked bend the bow; they have fitted their arrow to the string, to shoot in the dark at the upright in heart.
- **PNEUMA:** Look — the wicked are stringing their bows, fitting their arrows to the string, ready to shoot from the shadows at the honest and true.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
